report.summary: The write-mode gate that diffs before/after snapshots to verify actual disk changes appears missing from offload(): before_snap is computed but never compared to an after snapshot; no usage visible in this slice. This breaks the guarantee that self-reported model changes are not trusted. Also, isolate_paths claims safety based on worker writing only declared paths, but the repo_snapshot docstring admits the worker may write outside, making the scoped snapshot miss changes. Both are severity: high and medium.
risks: write verification gate missing in offload.py; write may succeed without verification
scoped snapshot for parallel dispatch may miss worker writes outside declared paths
todos: add after-snapshot and diff in offload to verify writes
clarify isolate_paths assumption and enforce path restriction or document risk

handoff.suggestion: In offload(), after worker.run, compute an after_snapshot using the same snap function, then compare before and after to detect changes; use that instead of trusting model's files_changed. Also, for isolate_paths, either enforce that the worker only writes to declared paths or fall back to full repo snapshot if unconstrained writes are possible.
